# onetsolutions_control_panels (Data Source)

Lists the control panels an instance can be installed with (its `control_panel` input).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_control_panels" "all" {}

output "control_panel_slugs" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_control_panels.all.control_panels[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `control_panels` (Attributes List) The control panels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_panels))

<a id="nestedatt--control_panels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_panels`

Read-Only:

- `access_port` (Number) The TCP port its web interface listens on.
- `compatible_image_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the images it installs on.
- `description` (String) What the control panel does.
- `docs_url` (String) The documentation of the control panel.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the control panel.
- `install_minutes_max` (Number) The longest installation time, in minutes.
- `install_minutes_min` (Number) The shortest installation time, in minutes.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) The smallest disk it needs, in GB.
- `min_ram_mb` (Number) The least memory it needs, in MB.
- `min_vcpu` (Number) The fewest virtual CPUs it needs.
- `name` (String) The name of the control panel.
- `slug` (String) The slug, for the instance's `control_panel`.
